PATHWAY MODULATION: PSA decreases (-28.7% at 2.0 mg, -33.1% at 2.7 mg) indicate downstream biological effects, suggesting the ADC mechanism may be working to some degree. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Mixed results across arms and endpoints. Part 1 showed success in 6-month rPFS for both dose levels (69% and 70% vs 47% control), but Part 2 ORR was a complete failure (0%). ORR in Part 1 was partial (13.6%) to successful (30.6%) depending on dose. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Significant safety concerns with cardiac toxicities (pericardial effusion 5.8%, atrial fibrillation 4.7%, cardiac arrest 2.3% in higher dose arm) may have limited dosing optimization. Trial stopped for business reasons rather than scientific failure.
